consent_p1: Location tracking is active ONLY while your assigned bus trip is in progress.
consent_p2: Tracking stops immediately when you tap 'End Trip'.
consent_p3: Data is used strictly for fleet dispatch, passenger arrival estimation, and safety.
perm_subtitle: Mandatory settings for reliable GPS capture
perm_step1: Step 1: Notifications — Enable foreground dispatch notification
perm_step2: Step 2: Precise Location — Set to 'Allow all the time'
perm_step3: Step 3: OEM Battery Saver — Set to 'No restrictions'
